}}'''Memara''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref/book|5|p}}

==Personality==
She seems to be a pleasant person, both in appearance and personality. However, she seems very strong-minded, never letting anything stand between herself and her goals. She was also willing to do anything that did not violate the [[Three Oaths]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Memara}}

== Strength and Abilities ==
Memara is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|40}}. This is marginally above [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength after she was healed from [[Stilling|Severing]].

== Activities ==
Memara was sent by [[Alviarin]] to Queen [[Tenobia]] in [[Saldaea]] as her personal advisor; her real purpose was to keep the queen under control and lessen [[Davram Bashere]]'s influence on her, but Memara failed and was unsuccessful in both; she was left behind when Tenobia went to meet the other [[Borderland]] rulers.{{ref/book|5|p}}

Elaida intended to have Tenobia kidnapped and brought to the White Tower as King [[Alsalam]] and King [[Mattin Stepaneos]];{{verify}} Likely Memara was initially part of this plan.

When the four rulers of the Borderlands met, they were accompanied by twelve Aes Sedai.{{ref/book|8|p}} When they later met the Dragon Reborn, there were thirteen. Possibly Memara was the thirteenth.{{verify}}
